a switch/match/when with 8 cases and a default
complexity.text:
func SeededSwitch(x int, y int) int {
	switch x {
	case 1:
		y = 1
	case 2:
		y = 2
	case 3:
		y = 3
	case 4:
		y = 4
	case 5:
		y = 5
	case 6:
		y = 6
	case 7:
		y = 7
	case 8:
		y = 8
	default:
		y = 0
	}
	return y
}

func SeededSpecial(x int, y int) int {
	switch {
	case x > 0:
		y = 0
	case x > 10:
		y = 1
	case x > 20:
		y = 2
	case x > 30:
		y = 3
	case x > 40:
		y = 4
	case x > 50:
		y = 5
	case x > 60:
		y = 6
	case x > 70:
		y = 7
	}
	return y
}
